name: app-lime-3d-building-model-phone-screen-with-yield-panel
title: Phone showing a lime-tinted 3D building over a frosted overview panel, with a flat detail card beside it
whatItIs: A light grey board 'UI Design 08' with a lime-green gradient rounded panel holding a phone whose top half is a lime-tinted 3D building on a white city model and a frosted sheet with the property overview, spec pills, ownership share, yield and returns; at the right, the same content flat with a market value line chart.
whatItMeans: Tangible and calm; a highlighted 3D building ties numbers to a place.
techniques: Tint one 3D building lime in a white city.
Slide a frosted info sheet over the model.
Show the same content flat next to the phone.

vocabulary.definition: A blurred panel over a map.
A stat showing the user's stake.
A component shown without a device.
